name: thai-flashcards
description: A lightweight, standalone web application for learning Thai vocabulary and phrases. It features category filtering, progress tracking (learned vs. hard cards), daily streaks, and text-to-speech audio.

scripts.clean: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/css dist/js dist/data
scripts.build:js: terser src/js/app.js -o dist/js/app.js --compress --mangle && terser src/data/flashcards.js -o dist/data/flashcards.js --compress --mangle
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run build:js && npm run build:css && npm run build:html
scripts.build:full: npm run build && npm run test:dist
